summary.zh: 让对员工、投资人和候选人的说法一致
summary.en: Keep one company story consistent across all audiences

description.zh: 为全员会、投资人更新、招聘沟通和危机说明准备一致的公司叙事，按受众调整重点但不动事实。会检查不同场合说辞之间的矛盾，并指出哪个版本更准确。适合多个受众会看到同一件事的时候。
description.en: Builds one company story for all-hands, investor updates, recruiting pitches and crisis messages, reframed per audience without changing facts. Flags contradictions between versions. Use when several audiences hear the same news.
